title: Te Whakamātautau o te Toka Pākarukaru
intro: Nā tētahi hapori pūkenga, whakahīhī hoki i whakairo tō rātou taonga tuku iho ki roto i ngā maunga. Engari i te taenga mai o tētahi tohu mārama ki a rātou, he whakamātautau i te whakapono me te manawanui, ka arahina rātou e tō rātou whakapehapeha ki te ara e kore e hoki mai. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei rōpū me te hua o tā rātou whakakeke?
clues: He tohunga mātou ki te kōhatu, i whakairo mātou i ngā whare whakahīhī ki ngā taha o ngā maunga.
I tae mai ki a mātou tētahi karere i roto i tō mātou iwi, e karanga ana i a mātou kia karakia ki te Atua Pono Kotahi.
I tono mātou i tētahi tohu hei whakaū i āna kupu, ā, i puta mai tētahi mea ahurei hei whakamātautau mā mātou.
I homai he whakahau māmā ki a mātou: kia tohaina te puna wai ki tēnei mea hanga, kia inu i te rā kua tohua mōna.
I roto i tō mātou whakapehapeha, ka whakatakoto whakaaro ētahi o mātou, ā, ka whakakeke mātou ki te whakatūpato, ka patua e mātou te mea hanga i whakaarohia hei tohu mō mātou.
E toru ngā rā i tukuna mai ki a mātou i mua i tō mātou aituā, kātahi ka pā mai tētahi pahūtanga nui ki a mātou i roto i ō mātou kāinga, ka mate mātou, ka hurihia.

identity.label: Ko wai tātou?
options: Ngā tāngata o 'Ad
Ngā tāngata o Madyan
Te iwi o Thamud
Ngā tāngata o Saba
Te iwi o Ruta

trial.label: He aha tā mātou whakamātautau matua?
options: Te hanga i tētahi āka hei oranga mō te waipuke
Te ātete i te hiahia ki te hī ika i te Rāhoroi
Te whakarērea o ngā mahi pakihi tinihanga
Te tiaki i tētahi kamera uha whakamiharo
Te manawanui ki te matekai e whitu tau te roa
trial.answer: Te tiaki i tētahi kamera uha whakamiharo

location.label: He aha te kaupapa matua o tā mātou kōrero?
options: Te Kuao Kau Koura
Te Kāmera Wahine
Te Rākau o te Poropiti a Mohi
Te Pā Nui o Ma'rib
Te Tēpu i Horahia mai i te Rangi

outcome.label: He aha tō tātou mutunga mutunga?
options: I toremi i roto i te waipuke nui
I hurihia hei makimaki me hei poaka
I pāngia e te hau nui
I mararahia e te pakaru o te tāke
I whakangaromia e te pahūtanga/rū whenua nui
outcome.answer: I whakangaromia e te pahūtanga/rū whenua nui

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
